role: Smoke suite for PDFReportGenerator: nil without analysis, every style/preset/section renders a readable multi-page PDF, degenerate inputs (no RR, flatline, single beat, nil DFA/LF-HF, every session type, history) do not trap, Arabic RTL mirroring of pages/text/header, box-alignment anchoring, and generateReportURL writes a readable temp file.
